name: 3D Video Editing Part 1
description: Autonomous 3D Video Director & Production Engine (Part 1 - Faceless Shorts): Make narrated faceless YouTube Shorts / TikToks / Reels fully in code: free local AI voice (Kokoro), Whisper word-synced captions, animated 3D & 2D shots, sound and music, rendered to MP4.
